input.note: Read the actual exported parameters. Reject mismatches; update and revalidate preprocessing and this contract together if quantization changes.

preprocessing.byte_order: explicit frame metadata; validate with sensor color bars
preprocessing.downsampling: For each 2x2 source block: gray=(Y00+Y01+Y10+Y11+2)/4 using integer division
preprocessing.mirror_note: Preview mirroring changes display coordinates only; training horizontal flips must swap left/right labels.

quality.statistics_domain: all 192*192 ROI source Y values before downsampling and quantization
quality.failure_behavior: Diagnostic tensor remains available; reject business inference and EMPTY re-arm evidence. Exposure convergence and exposure-policy changes are separate capture/application gates.

output.logits_processing: Dequantize with actual exported scale and zero point, then stable softmax exactly once.
output.probabilities_processing: Dequantize, validate each value and total within quantization tolerance, normalize rounding sum error. Do not apply softmax.
output.score_note: Comparison scores are not independently calibrated success probabilities.

business_threshold_debug_defaults.owner: Gesture module; calibrate with full temporal state machine and independent sessions

source_model_reference_only.reason: Source labels lack POINT_LEFT, POINT_RIGHT and V_SIGN; source no-gesture is not project EMPTY.
